slides.title: Tigray media agency gets a new licence
slides.body: Ethiopia's Media Authority renamed it Tigray Broadcasting Corporation.

slides.title: What the authority says
slides.body: It granted the licence after a request from Tigray's interim administration, reviewing it under the media proclamation.

slides.title: Why it had been suspended
slides.body: The authority says earlier content violated the media proclamation and endangered public security. Not independently verified.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: No response from the broadcaster or press groups was reported. Report is by state-affiliated Fana.

slides.title: Press freedom and open information matter.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
